pages.text: The Sky Necklace connects the player's inventory to a selected Sky line through an item whitelist. It requires a whitelist Filter List containing at least one item; it does nothing without a filter or with a blacklist. It works in a Curios slot when available, or from the player's main inventory otherwise.

pages.title: Three Modes
pages.text: $(bold)Extract$() sends matching player-side items to the line. $(bold)Insert$() takes matching items from the line and puts them on the player side. $(bold)Maintain$() targets the player's main inventory, inserting shortages and sending away excess. Maintain needs a slot or quantity target above zero.

The necklace upgrade slots accept a Dimension Upgrade for access to same-line endpoints in other loaded dimensions. Enter the maintain target directly; its button switches between item and slot counts, with slots as the default. Slot-count maintenance fills existing matching slots without opening slots beyond the target.
The necklace tries to move items periodically but does not load chunks. If a target is unloaded or full, it keeps the items where they are and tries again later.
